verdict: Safe to integrate the native selected-field host implementation; no material behavior regression found. One formatter-only indentation finding is recorded below.
host_integration_status: Implemented and covered by local controller, prompt/dialog and adjacent lifecycle tests. This supersedes the earlier a83700c6 implementation-pending bound only.
reviewed_behaviors: Native protocol callbacks now use WordZoteroTransaction.handle; explicit Field.select publishes only validated original-source context.
QudsWordEditor passes active source ranges to WordCanvas independently of writing selection, Notes target and focus.
Native alert and progress views present bounded source excerpts, source location and pending-import/insertion explanation. Alert button return codes are preserved.
Completion, callback errors, cancellation completion and route disposal retire presentation. Stale document, writing target or host state suppress context and reject staged result.
Viewport reveal and guarded restoration preserve deliberate user scroll/zoom; older cleanup cannot clear a newer operation context.
Staged updates remain unpublished until successful complete/apply and commit as one undoable operation.
